spec_match.rationale: Exercises RTCStartDiagnosticLoggingOptions (allowUpload with the spec default false stated, metadata record<DOMString,DOMString>) AND the finish-side RTCFinishDiagnosticLoggingOptions closing metadata that the v150 predecessor did not cover — both validated against the spec's 5-entry/100-char limits; the TypeError(spec)-vs-RangeError(Chromium rtc.cc RejectWithRangeError, re-verified against main 2026-08-16) divergence and the UTF-8-bytes nuance are presented as labelled divergences, not errors.

interactive.rationale: Metadata rows add/remove with live over-limit preview (announced via aria-live), allowUpload checkbox, closing-metadata inputs with their own limit note, and start/finish buttons that make the real calls and stamp the bug-report stub; unbound browsers keep the full metadata-validation preview working with the start button honestly disabled.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index card now includes the finish-with-closing-metadata capability and matches the delivered page, including the divergence note.

edge_cases.rationale: Over-limit entry count and over-length values previewed live on both the start and finish options, the rejection branch asserts the enforced error name (either TypeError or RangeError proves enforcement), the UTF-8 vs JS-length nuance is documented, and the unbound branch is explicit.

references.rationale: See-also cites chromestatus.com/feature/5091582546149376; the lede links the Chromium rtc.cc implementation directly; the flag note links the origin-trial registration.

conformance.rationale: The new v151 feature suite asserts both metadata-limit rejections on start AND the new finish-validates-metadata contract this page demonstrates, binding-agnostically; executed live on the conformance route (honest 1 pass / 7 fail in the unbound harness).

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven interaction run (headless Chromium 141, the sanctioned cloud fallback): added rows to 6 entries (over-limit warning + .over class appeared), removed a row (count returned to 5), typed a 101-char closing value (finish-side warning appeared), screenshots captured and read at desktop and 360px; zero console errors. PARTIAL because the harness browser predates the API, so the real start/finish calls and the actual RangeError rejection could not be runtime-verified.

telemetry_health.rationale: Branch asserts: rtc-start-with-metadata, rtc-metadata-limit-enforced, rtc-finish-with-metadata, rtc-finish-metadata-limit-enforced, and rtc-companion-unavailable-fallback (observed firing in the unbound harness); no failed same-origin requests during validation.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; table header inverts background+color together; inputs use bg-paper/text-black; over-limit notes use accent-rose on light background; no static-card pattern.

accessibility.rationale: fieldset/legend group both option sets, per-row aria-labels on key/value inputs and remove buttons, labelled closing-metadata inputs, aria-live on both limit notes and the status line, a visually-hidden header labels the remove column, and the report stub is plain text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness desktop OK / mobile OK; this concept measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 with zero console errors, and the 360px screenshot was read: metadata table fits with usable inputs, closing-metadata grid collapses to one column below 480px, buttons full-width. Remove buttons are ~30px (above the 24px WCAG 2.2 floor, below the 44px ideal) — acknowledged, consistent with the v150 family.

openQuestions.title: Runtime-verify the real RangeError rejection and finish-with-metadata on Chrome 151+ behind the flag
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 in the verification environment predates the API, so the over-limit rejection path and the finishDiagnosticLogging({ metadata }) call were validated only against Chromium source (rtc.cc, rtc_diagnostic_logging_options.idl) and the spec, not live. On Chrome 151+ with --enable-blink-features=RTCDiagnosticLogging, submit 6 entries and a 101-char value on both start and finish and confirm the rejection name matches the page copy; update the copy if Chromium aligns with the spec's TypeError.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible dynamic form validation warnings and named table inputs
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Associate labels with inputs, announce dynamic validation through live regions, keep semantic table headers, and give icon-only buttons accessible names.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: aria-live on both limit notes, per-row aria-labels on inputs and ✕ buttons, visually-hidden text labelling the remove column header, fieldset/legend for the two option groups.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP interaction run 2026-08-16: over-limit note text observed updating live after row edits

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form table and two-column grid without horizontal overflow on narrow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let grids collapse to one column at narrow widths and allow long tokens to wrap rather than force width.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: close-grid collapses to 1 column under 480px; overflow-wrap:anywhere on code; measured 0px overflow at 360×740.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: mobile-check CDP run 2026-08-16: scrollWidth − innerWidth = 0 at 360px

summary: v151 adaptation with a substantive addition over the v150 predecessor: closing metadata on finishDiagnosticLogging (RTCFinishDiagnosticLoggingOptions, present in both the spec and Chromium main IDL but undemonstrated in v150), with its own live limit validation and telemetry asserts. Divergence copy re-verified against Chromium main (RangeError, UTF-8 byte measurement) and the spec (TypeError) on 2026-08-16. Interactions verified via CDP in the unbound harness; the bound rejection path is an open question for a flag-capable Chrome 151+.
